title: MML group: which shortlisted training configuration to name for the NSSMP 2027 slot, and the benchmark loss to state
domain: Machine Learning Research, General Statistics & Data Science

sources.origin: generated for this task. Every training run is a real optimisation run of a small classifier (the generator's own trainer) on a simulated population of survey points with three simulated labelling routes; the cluster, tracking, store and benchmark records are simulated around those runs. The research group, the contractor, the programme and the people are invented.
